# Test data

`Bernard-SP/` is an unmodified clone of the Maniac Mansion Mania "Bernard Starterpack" (saved with
AGS 3.6.0.53), the reference game for all automated tests. It is not part of this repository:
`git clone https://github.com/ManiacMansionMania/Bernard-SP.git testdata/Bernard-SP` (tested at `fa24c33`). Tests only ever work on temporary copies
or read it; never open it in the editor. Experiment with `mmm-bernhard-sp/` or `build/editor-demo/` instead.
